entries.title: Give a custom model its own name and price
entries.body: Each model on a custom connection now has a Name and price part: a display name, its prices in US dollars per million tokens, and a Free switch. A model the catalog does not know gets an estimate in Usage, a free one counts as costing nothing, and changing the name or prices saves without checking the model again.

picture.alt: A custom model's line with its Name and price part open, showing a display name and four prices
